name: cs-shift-handover
description: Writes a shift or holiday handover for support work, with open tickets in SBAR form showing owner and promise made, who talks to each customer, and a holiday cover sheet. Use for "run cs-shift-handover", "I cannot take a holiday", "holiday handover for support", "shift handover template", "hand over my open tickets", "cover sheet while I am away", "everything is tied to me", part of the AI for Customer Service Pack by 90n.
